en-US.longDescription:
PDF Shaper is a powerful yet lightweight Windows application for offline PDF processing.
- Convert PDF documents to MS Word DOC, text, or image files and convert those formats back to PDF.
- Remove XMP, usage rights, metadata, bookmarks, annotations, form fields, images, and other elements.
- Encrypt PDFs with AES encryption algorithm and user password, set document permissions, sign files.
- Rename PDF files, modify metadata, extract content - text (plain, OCR or CSV) or images.
- Merge, split, or watermark with text and images.
- Rotate, crop, insert, move, delete, or extract pages.

Free 7-day trial
